software_name: Docker Engine (docker-ce, docker-ce-cli, containerd.io, docker-buildx-plugin, docker-compose-plugin, docker-ce-rootless-extras)

install_command: sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg >/dev/null && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y gh

wget -qO - https://download.sublimetext.com/sublimehq-pub.gpg | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/sublimehq-pub.asc >/dev/null && printf 'Types: deb
URIs: https://download.sublimetext.com/
Suites: apt/stable/
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/sublimehq-pub.asc
' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sublime-text.sources && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y sublime-text
sudo apt install -y sublime-merge  # uses the Sublime Text apt repo above

wget -qO - https://deb.tableplus.com/apt.tableplus.com.gpg.key | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/tableplus-archive.gpg >/dev/null && sudo add-apt-repository -y "deb [arch=amd64] https://deb.tableplus.com/debian/26 tableplus main" && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y tableplus

echo 'deb [arch=i386,amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/dropbox.asc] http://linux.dropbox.com/ubuntu resolute main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/dropbox.list && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y dropbox  # get dropbox.asc from dropbox.com/install-linux

echo 'deb [arch=amd64,arm64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/claude-desktop-archive-keyring.asc] https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-desktop/apt/stable stable main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/claude-desktop.list && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y claude-desktop  # get keyring from claude.ai/download

printf 'Types: deb
URIs: https://persistent.oaistatic.com/codex-app-prod/linux/deb
Suites: stable
Components: main
Architectures: amd64
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/chatgpt-archive-keyring.gpg
' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/chatgpt.sources && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y chatgpt  # get keyring from developers.openai.com/codex/app
# download the Linux tar.gz from syntevo.com/smartgit/download, then: sudo tar -xzf smartgit-linux-*.tar.gz -C /opt && /opt/smartgit/bin/add-menuitem.sh

for f in CascadiaCode JetBrainsMono Meslo; do mkdir -p ~/.local/share/fonts/$f && curl -fsSL https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/latest/download/$f.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local/share/fonts/$f; done && fc-cache -f
mkdir -p ~/AppImages && gh release download --repo usebruno/bruno --pattern '*_x86_64_linux.AppImage' -O ~/AppImages/bruno.appimage && chmod +x ~/AppImages/bruno.appimage
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo && flatpak install -y flathub it.mijorus.gearlever
